//: The ttsc/Go lowering config read by @ttsc/unplugin/bun during the Bun.build JS emit (build.ts): add-with-transformer-examples.ts and infrastructure-greeting-workshop.ts use the tokenless addClass<I>()/addFactory<I>()/.as<>() registration sugar, types.ts uses typefor<T>(), and LocatorGreetingWorkshop uses the tokenless resolve<T>()/tryResolve<T>()/isService<T>() sugar. Stage selection is declare-by-depending, resolved HOST-SIDE: there is no `plugins` array, so ttsc auto-discovery spawns the one owner host (transforms/cmd/ttsc-std) from this lib's direct di.extras devDep, and the host self-selects the full stage set from its own dependency scan — the generic inline stage plus the primitive stages inline/nameof/typefor/signatureof/schemaof/mergesynth reached through di.extras's honest primitives.extras dep. The registration verbs and resolve<T>()/tryResolve<T>()/isService<T>() are all substituted from di.extras's rhombus-std inline bodies (the same host scan collects them), then the primitive stages lower the resulting typefor/signatureof calls under the fixed-point loop; mergesynth is inert here (this lib installs no augmentation). Extends the base tsconfig. The `types` augmentation is RETAINED: the tokenless `addClass<I>()` / `resolve<T>()` sugar is NOT a real di.core method — it lives in di.extras's `declare module '@rhombus-std/di.core'` augment, and declaration-site matching anchors on that sugar overload, so the augment must be in the Go program. Lint and d.ts emit stay on plain tsc via the base tsconfig.json.
